body.p: After . Owns include/sxml/xquery.h, include/sxml/serialize.h. xquery.h: a compiled main module (lifecycle quintet, ) from text with the shared static context configuration; library modules found through the resolver kind XQUERY_MODULE (2.2); evaluation with the shared dynamic context; the serialization parameters the prolog declares, readable by the caller. serialize.h: methods xml, xhtml, html, text, json, csv, adaptive; one parameters struct with every Serialization 4.0 parameter (indent, omit-xml-declaration, standalone, doctype-system/public, cdata-section- elements, suppress-indentation, undeclare-prefixes, encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, US-ASCII, ISO-8859-1), byte-order-mark, normalization-form, html-version, include-content-type, escape-uri-attributes, item-separator, json-node-output-method, allow-duplicate-names, escape-solidus, canonical, use-character-maps); parameters from an output:serialization-parameters element or a map (SEPM0017, SEPM0019). Done when the header check, lints and rubric pass and 3.3, 3.12 and the driver can be written against them. Done 2026-10-17 (): xquery.h (sxml_xquery_query, evaluation request, sxml_xquery_query_get_serialization_parameters); serialize.h with every parameter, sxml_serialization_flag, encodings, character maps and sxml_serialization_parameter_reader. Follow-up for 3.3: non-adaptive methods should return UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE until implemented.
